impact: The Data Directory section ends with 'No database. No cloud sync. Plain files.' This directly contradicts the HTTP transport / Fly.io deployment path and will confuse users who followed the deploy guide.
resolution: Updated README Data Directory section: replaced 'No database. No cloud sync.' with accurate description noting HTTP/Fly users get remote storage on a persistent Fly volume synced across machines automatically.
title: README data dir section says 'No cloud sync' — wrong for HTTP/Fly users
